headline: Postponed RMG wage board meeting rescheduled for 23 Nov; owners' proposal expected
summary: The wage board for garment workers has rescheduled its meeting to 23 November. The owners' side was due to submit a proposal on minimum wage rates at the panel's third meeting.
why: Ready-made garments are Bangladesh's largest export industry, so minimum wage decisions affect labour costs for global apparel brands that source from the country.
